_comment: Phase 2a acceptance targets, checked by acceptance.py against a
run_suite.py report. They are absolute (or relative to the
diarization-off run of the same report, or to the committed Phase 2
baseline), measured in the Linux CPU reference container (4 CPUs,
8 GB). Production hardware is unknown, so capacity is defined per
session; the concurrency step reports how many sessions the container
sustains. A missed target is reported by how much, never relaxed here.

caption p50 within 10% of diarization of.note: chunk-id method, in-progress captions; captions must never wait for diarization

no caption periods dropped because of di.note: dropped periods with diarization on must not exceed the off run in the same environment

diarization CPU at most 1 core per sessi.note: mean cores of the diarization worker over the streamed window

diarization extra RAM at most 1 GB per s.note: peak RSS of the diarization worker (model plus one window)

diarization real-time factor at most 0.3.note: diarization compute seconds per second of audio received, from the service counters

speaker label at most 2 s after caption.note: per finalized word, from the message that first showed it to the message that labelled it

labels never change after being sent.note: a speakers_update disagreeing with a label already sent

label corrections before finalization at.note: words whose in-progress label differed from their finalized label

streaming settled DER no worse than the.note: accuracy targets are Phase 2b's job; this only guards against a regression
